title: Italian-Style Shrimp Bake
description: A light and flavorful Italian-inspired shrimp bake with a crispy top.
instructions: Rinse the shrimp and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, mix together the chili flakes, garlic, and olive oil.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the chili flake mixture.
Transfer the shrimp to a baking dish and top with breadcrumbs and mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the shrimp are cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
